task: Preserve lexical for-loop shadowing while closing an outer open Vector type.
observation: At base 7c3f18d, the compiler rejected a valid read-only loop over Vector[Int] when the loop variable shadowed an outer empty Vector later closed to String. Renaming only the loop variable made the same program check and run. The flat BodyTypeState local map let the inner use constrain or read the outer term before lexical restoration.
impact: The type diagnostic appeared at the inner use even though the source error was compiler scope contamination; a reduced native-safe regression was needed to isolate it.
evidence: ./moss check tests/for_shadow_open_type.moss --json at 7c3f18d: TYPE_MISMATCH on the first(values) call

resolution.summary: The scoped for-binding repair passes the reduced Moss check, native execution, and the Phase 25 Team A semantics suite.

task: Keep branch-confined collection identities separate from later same-name bindings.
observation: At base 7c3f18d and milestone a1ebd7a, a Vector first made inside if, while, or for incorrectly constrained a later Vector with the same name. A name-keyed closed_projection also projected the later binding's element type back onto the earlier declaration during source-order checking.
impact: Valid branch-local code failed at the inner push; the diagnostic named a mismatched item even though the actual cause was a stale cross-scope projection.

resolution.summary: Lexical prepass frames and statement-keyed binding snapshots pass the reduced check, native execution, and Phase 25 Team A semantics suite.
